question: Among superheroes published by Marvel Comics who have an attribute value between 70 and 90, find the name of the one with the highest number of superpowers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1."XCL_026" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_012"
WHERE T2."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T3."XCL_011" BETWEEN 70 AND 90
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018", T1."XCL_019"
ORDER BY COUNT(T5."XCL_012") DESC
LIMIT 1
